summary.desc: Miraculous drops said to have fallen from the eyes of a goddess.

raw.name: Angel Tear

dictionary.lore: These rare drops are said to be the fallen tears of a goddess. It's said that the miraculous power hidden in these drops grant her divine protection to inanimate objects. There are no drops remaining in Elgaia, but powerful spirits and demons sealed away in Grand Gaia occasionally drop them.
